hypervelocity stars (HVSs), stars which have velocities in the Galactic reference frame that are high enough to achieve escape velocity

Upon visual inspection of HVS candidates, it is found that several lie on this “binary main sequence”, including but not necessarily limited to Gaia DR2 1540013339194597376, which can be identified to be a HVS candidate via its proper motion of 900 km/s alone (Bromley et al. 2018), and Gaia DR2 1976597452042003072, with a proper motion of 500 km/s.
